name: Viral Swipe File
description: Know what to post next on TikTok and Instagram Reels: search a curated library of viral videos by topic, creator, niche or format, open a video for its hook, caption, views and viral factor (its views against the account's usual), and write new hooks and content ideas from real posts. Six read-only tools. Hosted MCP with OAuth sign-in; a free Viral Swipe File account is required.
author: Viral Swipe File
